Aquaculture Stewardship Council
Document Name
ASC Farm Standard -
Interpretation Manual 
Document ID ASC-INT-001 Version 1.0 Page 21 of 511
How do I interpret this requirement? 
o Indicator 2.12.1 requires the UoC to only use ASC-conforming compound feed. 
• Use of non-conforming feed will be treated as a non-conformity against Indicator 2.12.1.
o For product which is sold under the segregation model, identifying the feed production model 
and distinct feed name is required by the ASC Feed Standard, Indicator 3.3.2.
Evidence of implementation should be maintained, e.g.: 
o Process to confirm the originating feed mill holds valid certification against the ASC Feed 
Standard. 
o Records:
• traceability system and its verification, for example:
- use of a digital traceability system
- outcome of any input-output exercises and traceability tests.
• accompanying documents incorporating information required by 1.4.3(c), (d) and (e).
Auditors should confirm:
o Process to confirm the originating feed mill holds valid certification against the ASC Feed 
Standard. 
o Effective traceability and segregation systems are in place.
o Outcome of any input-output exercises and traceability tests.
Useful Resources
N/A
c. documentation accompanying the feed identifies the feed as ASC-conforming; and
d. documentation accompanying the feed identifies the production model applied (i.e. 
Mass Balance Production Model or Segregation Production Model); and 
e. for ASC-conforming Segregation Production Model feed, the product is identifiable 
by a distinct feed name in formal documentation accompanying the product and is 
listed on the schedule to the feed mill certificate.
